content.summary: The expanded project rebuild strengthens local assurance without eliminating the disclosed compiler, package-cache, and shared-controller assumptions. Manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. The skeptical reproducibility challenge does not require revision.

checks.scope: Remaining trust after project source rebuilding
checks.method: Inspected both F29 drivers, verified composite child-summary hashes, and checked all 100 inherited and fourteen new module receipts for successful exits and stable source hashes.
checks.observation: All 114 receipts pass these checks. The inherited driver requires a fresh output directory and passes its resulting base-build to replay; package object directories remain explicitly on LEAN_PATH. Revision matching does not authenticate those objects or the Lean executable. The report discloses this retained trust and shared host/controller, and qualifies the child's generic cached-base wording. These artifacts neither reproduce external canonical enumeration nor independently certify its coverage; the manuscript treats that result as an external report and retains the local exclusion obligation.
